paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Critic model choices. Both follow the SIM-RAG setting with GPT-4 as the Reasoner, but the blue bar uses learned Flan-T5-783M as a Critic, while the red bar uses GPT-4 as the Critic (a.k.a., self-critique).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of two different Critic models, both within a SIM-RAG framework utilizing GPT-4 as the reasoner. The horizontal axis represents the model names, displayed in alphabetical order as “TriviaQA (EM) HotPotQA (EM),” “2Wiki (EM),” “TriviaQA (F1) HotPotQA (F1),” and “2Wiki (F1).” The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” ranges from 25 to 85 and utilizes a linear scale, with tick labels incrementing by 10. The blue bars correspond to the Flan-T5-783M Critic model, with a height of approximately 77.1, and the red bars represent the GPT-4 Critic model, exhibiting a height of approximately 83.8. The shortest blue bar represents a score of 31.9, while the tallest blue bar measures 82.8. The tallest red bar displays a score of 83.8, and the shortest red bar is placed at 53.3.  Each bar is colored distinctly, with the blue bars representing the Flan-T5-783M Critic and the red bars illustrating the GPT-4 Critic model.
